**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/18 (Sat) 20:34
- [EVENT] The Commonpoint Challenge is a fundraising event similar to a walkathon.
- [TEMPORAL] The Commonpoint Challenge takes place between April 1 - April 21, 2023.
- [FACT] Participants can choose their own challenge activity and complete it anywhere during the event period.
- [FACT] 100% of all proceeds from the Commonpoint Challenge will provide critical financial support for community programs and services.
- [RELATIONSHIP] Supporters are referred to as "YOU," indicating a direct appeal to the audience.
- [FACT] The funds raised will help provide food, mental health services, employment support, and more to the community.
- [EVENT] Prizes will be awarded to the top three fundraisers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To learn more and view challenge suggestions, visit CommonpointQueens.org/Challenge.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Participants are encouraged to post their challenge stories and tag Commonpoint Queens using the hashtag #CommonpointChallenge.
